source_support.denominator_policy: Each feeling slope uses its own complete rows. Each comparison with sad fits both feelings on the same complete rows.
source_support.limit: Failure and feeling share a prompt. Unequal answer noise across the two contexts can produce the registered contrast.
source_support.ratios: Signed slope in the comparison over the reference. Denominators at or below 1e-12 in magnitude are undefined.
source_support.success_occurrence: Failure equals seven minus success. Success occurrence is perfectly separated by design.
